title.value: From Appearance to Motion: Aligning Visual Representations for Robotic Manipulation

TLDR.value: We pre-train motion sensitive representations, finding they outperform generic vision backbones in behavioral cloning.

abstract.value: Pre-trained vision models used in robotics often misalign with manipulation tasks due to the loss used to train these vision models being focused on appearance rather than motion. In order to enhance motion encoding within vision models, we introduce a simple novel contrastive training framework that operates over predictions of motion. After training over EPIC Kitchens, model evaluations on behavioral cloning show a improvement in success rate over state-of-the-art methods across a benchmark of $3$ environments and $21$ object manipulation tasks.
